headline: From unprofitable and overwhelmed to 3x revenue and 4x profit in three years
before: Not long after his first daughter was born, Akram felt lost. His jewelry brand looked like a real company from the outside, but it was messy, it was not profitable, and it had no foundation under it. He felt like giving up, and he did not even know how, because the business felt bigger than him.
what_was_done: Akram built a three-year Vivid Vision starting from the ideal scenario, not from his current numbers. He built it with his leadership team so everyone bought in at the same time. The engagement included an energy audit, quarterly rocks, and regular check-ins that held him and his team to the decisions they made.
results: Business revenue tripled in three years
Profit quadrupled in the same three years
Removed roles that should not have been in the company and made the hires that should have been
Took Q4 travel with his family for the first time while that season posted its highest numbers ever
quote: Both my life and my business improved at the same time, without sacrificing one for the other.
permission: granted 2026-09-01, first name only per Jennifer
needs: Exact starting and ending revenue figures and headcount would strengthen this.

headline: A drifting business rebuilt around one written three-year vision, in weeks
before: Dan had sold his house, moved onto a boat, and let the business run on cruise control. When it started needing his attention again, he realized he was uncomfortable with where both the business and his life were heading. He saw Jennifer speak on stage and booked a VIP day.
what_was_done: A one-on-one VIP day to draft the Vivid Vision, personal life first, then the business reverse-engineered from it. Then a structured rollout to his team and business associates so everyone worked from the same three-year picture.
results: Whole business model changed within three weeks of starting
Every decision now runs through a clear business vision that also supports his personal life
Team and associates work from a written three-year vision, so alignment is not a question
Designed the business to fund the life he wanted: keep the house, get back on the ocean, still do the work
quote: From the moment I walked in the door, I never had to guess how I was going to get from here to there.
permission: granted 2026-09-01, first name only per Jennifer
needs: Any revenue or client-volume numbers Dan will share.

headline: A retreat that birthed a scalable company that hit every three-year benchmark
before: Stacy and her husband ran a high-ticket business working one-on-one with clients. It worked, but it did not scale. They attended the Vision Driven retreat expecting to sit around and make vision boards.
what_was_done: The retreat, then a full three-year Vivid Vision, then a VIP planning day that started with every facet of their personal life and reverse-engineered the business from it. Then a team rollout with hand-mailed vision packets opened like an unboxing.
results: The retreat directly inspired the creation of Share One, a more scalable business
Hit every three-year benchmark they set for a company that started as just a seed
Two investors approached them unprompted within a month of each other, matching a vision item set three years earlier
Tighter team culture, with people raising their hands to own pieces of the vision
quote: We didn't know how we were going to do it, but with Vision Driven, it just worked.
permission: granted 2026-09-01, first name only per Jennifer
needs: Investment amounts and revenue milestones if Stacy will share.
